text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test),No need for English medium programs * 2. Certificate of Bank saving or Income Certificate of Financial Guarantor You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Personal statement or study plan (600 words at least). * 4. Study and Work Experience Resume since High School to present The start and end time must be uninterrupted, and education level should start from senior high school). Applicants must fully disclose their prior learning experiences in China. If any concealment or misrepresentation is confirmed, the university reserves the right to unconditionally revoke the admission at its sole discretion. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Photocopy of foreigner physical examination form The medical examinations must cover all the items listed and should be conducted after October 1st, 2025. 6. Other attachments Applicants for architectural majors are requested to submit five sketches of the applicants’ own works. * 7. Photocopy of passport within the validity period after September 1st, 2026. * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Scan of notarized copy of the high school academic transcripts or scan of international standardization test results Such as SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB etc. * 10. Scan of original high school diploma or original notarized diploma. Scan of pre-graduation certificate is required if the applicants have not gained certificate. Please resubmit the original highest diploma or original notarized diploma before registration * 11. Applicants must submit scan of Certificate of Non-Criminal Records It should be valid within six months prior to the application date. (Fresh high school graduates are required to submit a certificate that shows the applicant's good record of conduct and performance in their school). * 12. Digital Signature Please sign your name on a white paper, and send us a scan copy of it; We will only use it to help you digitally sign some related documents during the application process. * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
